name: jumpcut-android-build
//: prepare-assets bundles the server + web UI into app/src/main/assets/nodejs-project/.
It is run automatically by the Gradle preBuild hook; run it by hand after
changing server or web code if you want to inspect the bundle.
fetch-libnode downloads the pinned nodejs-mobile release into jniLibs + cpp headers.
Requires `npm install` at the repo root first (esbuild resolves hono etc. from the workspace).
